spans.text: The share of an item's elapsed time during which someone is actually working on it.
An approximation of expected queue time as a utilization term times a variability term times the mean service time, for a single server under heavy load.
Over a long enough period, the average number of items in a system equals their arrival rate times the average time each spends inside.
Capacity deliberately left unallocated so that unpredictable work can be absorbed without forming a queue.
A system whose arrivals and completions balance over the measurement window.
Introduced earlier as one where items leave, on average, as fast as they arrive.
Items that have been started but not finished.
An explicit cap on the number of items a team or person may have started but not finished.
